criterion_quoted_from_HEAD.text: ACCURACY (curve-of-growth-tied large aperture). On isolated, unsaturated, constant bright stars, d(s) = median_epochs(m_psf_inst - m_L_inst), where m_L is a large-aperture (r_L ~ 4 x FWHM) instrumental magnitude tied by a measured growth curve. Fit d = a + b*(G - 10): |b| <= 5.0 mmag/mag and robust scatter (1.4826 * MAD) <= 15 mmag. The colour slope c of d vs BP-RP is RECORDED (expected ~0; a nonzero value would indicate PSF colour dependence), not judged. No catalogue transformation and no blended star enters the reference.
